title: OTWD ferry service, repository form
description: A ferry service as its file in a data repository holds it (ADR 0046): the full form in ferry-service.schema.json without the values OTWD computes when the loader reads the file. Provenance has no confidence or change_seq, and the record has no updated_at, change_seq or derived values. Everything else, the facts, their provenance and the lifecycle rules, is the full form's.
